name: vgs_physics_ai_event_reliability_v4_augmented_measurement
status: independent training protocol after context-v2 downstream audit
purpose: Train a small physics-context event-reliability network with asymmetric source protection, sparsity augmentation, synthetic event labels, and a mechanics displacement constraint.
preserved_properties: 14 causal physical descriptors and 100 event-centred context descriptors
timestamp-aligned original-event subset; no frame accumulation
fixed 5 ms future context with real post-window events loaded in EBIV
historical VGS, raw event files, Table 1 values, and prior results are never overwritten
training_data: frozen context-v2 train and validation caches plus a small synthetic translated-event auxiliary set; no held-out hot-plate files are read

loss.classification: weighted BCE with positive/source-event weight 3.0 to penalize false rejection
loss.sparsity_augmentation: deterministic feature dropout during training: 5% physics features and 10% context features
loss.synthetic_supervision: known source/noise labels from translated-event pairs are appended only to the physics-context branch
loss.measurement: differentiable weighted-centroid displacement loss; each phase includes signal and injected-noise events
loss.objective: L = L_asymmetric_BCE + 0.20 L_measurement for the physics-context branch

measurement_auxiliary.phase_definition: phase 1 is [100000,102000) us and phase 2 is [110000,112000) us; noise events falling in either interval are included in the weighted centroid
measurement_auxiliary.selection_role: training regularizer and auxiliary labels only; not an evaluation label

selection.model: highest macro validation ROC-AUC among the three learned branches
selection.threshold: largest validation threshold with mean source recall >= 0.98 and minimum per-case recall >= 0.95
selection.mechanics_gate: validation EBOS EPE, coverage, failure, and low-density behavior are reported; held-out test values are not used for selection

evaluation.primary: event reliability plus EBIV/EBOS measurement metrics
evaluation.statistics: three frozen training seeds; case means then mean/sample SD; no best-seed reporting
evaluation.label_boundary: source events are proxy positives and injected events proxy negatives, not absolute clean/noise truth
evaluation.reference_boundary: EBIV and EBOS references are source-derived reference solutions, not independent physical ground truth
